developmentNote: A historical React Fast Refresh dependency-length warning occurred while adding the inspection camera. It is retained in controls.json; the final code was rechecked after a clean load with no new errors.
limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Chosen conductances, densities and damage thresholds, not calibrated specimen data or fracture predictions.
Separate matched specimens for water and empty-drop tests.
Fixed leakage geometry; no wetting delay, swelling, collapse or evaporation.
Drop ignores rotation, bounce, impact force and fragments; floor contact is perfectly inelastic.
Cutaways and damage markers are display aids; numerical values use full-cup geometry.
Collector displacement and schematic drip transit volume are neglected.
No food-contact, drinking-water, hygiene or environmental certification.
